t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Green, orange and yellow gnomes take me to one forest, while the other colored gnomes take me to a different forsest. I'm to stick to one forest until I exhaust it, and then switch to the other one, and repeat this until I am out of rounds. If it seems as if I am getting low yields on both forest, I should stick to one forest for 4-5 rounds and then try switching.

vb_textbox.text: There are two forests. Green, orange, yellow, and blue gnomes will take you to one forest, and the other colored gnomes will take you to the other. Stick with one forest at a time, and stay until you're getting 0-2 mushrooms. Switch to the other forest, and repeat this process. Sometimes you will notice that both forests are producing low yields. When this happens, stick to one forest for 4-5 rounds, and then switch to the other.
